answers.core:
The vertex buffer is internal renderer state and cannot be accessed externally. This proposal simply exposes an existing RID, following the same pattern already used for MultiMesh.

It’s a minimal change that enables GPU-driven mesh workflows across all GDExtension use cases.
answers.workaround:
Workarounds exist but all break the GPU-only pipeline:

- **CPU readback:** `buffer_get_data`  -> rebuild + re-upload every frame
- **Custom renderer:** bypass ArrayMesh entirely, losing built-in features (materials, culling, shadows, instancing)

title: Expose mesh surface RD buffer RIDs to GDExtension
